name: livecheck-verify-then-confirm
description: Hardcode these two tools into an agent tool list. Verify accepts x402 (Base USDC) or MPP (Tempo USDC.e). Each charges exactly $0.01. MPP method is tempo/charge: USDC.e on Tempo (chain 4217). Stripe pays Tempo gas. With MPP (Tempo): Paid answers, including the checked link, are kept for 24 hours so retries are safe, then deleted. Confirm is x402 on Base ($0.10). Actor ≠ verifier.

tools.name: livecheck_verify
tools.description: Check whether a specific job, Shopify/HTML product, or eBay item URL is still live. Returns live|closed|unknown. Unpaid 402 offers x402 (Base USDC) or MPP (Tempo USDC.e). Each charges exactly $0.01. Optional: Authorization Bearer lc_live_… from https://livecheck.fly.dev/keys (GitHub sign-in, 200 free checks / 30 days on the verify routes only). Confirm stays wallet-only. MPP method is tempo/charge: USDC.e on Tempo (chain 4217). Stripe pays Tempo gas. With MPP (Tempo): Paid answers, including the checked link, are kept for 24 hours so retries are safe, then deleted. On 503 over_capacity or x402 processor_unavailable, wait for Retry-After and retry; you were not charged. An MPP 503 payment_unconfirmed means a possible charge is logged for refund, and retrying with the same credential is safe and never charges twice. For a list of URLs, send up to 8 checks at a time.

url.description: Absolute job, product, or eBay /itm/ URL

tools.name: confirm_lead_submit
tools.description: Independent check that a lead_submit side effect landed (actor ≠ verifier). Requires Level-2 evidence (ref/ticket/lead id). Thank-you copy alone is never confirmed. $0.10 USDC on Base via x402. Unpaid → HTTP 402.
